exact_question: How does Pilfering resolve ties, zero conservation, or selecting yourself as affected player?
exact_raw_answer: 1. Ties among eligible highest-appeal or most-conservation targets are chosen by the acting player; a most-conservation target must have at least 1 conservation. Thus a player with zero conservation is not eligible as the conservation target. 2. If the same zoo is both highest on appeal and most conservation, Pilfering 2 affects it twice. Self-targeting has no effect. 3. The summary does not say what Pilfering 2 does if no player has at least 1 conservation, so that case is unsupported.

- **Standard enclosure:** any animal except a Petting Zoo animal may go alone into an empty standard enclosure of at least its printed minimum size. Flip the entire enclosure to its occupied side.
     - **Petting Zoo:** Petting Zoo animals go only here.
     - **Reptile House or Large Bird Aviary:** all reptiles and some birds show an alternative special-enclosure requirement. You may choose that housing instead. Put the indicated number of supply player tokens on its free spaces; if not enough free spaces remain, the animal cannot go there. Never flip a special enclosure.
     - **Water and rock:** the animal's required adjacency applies to the chosen enclosure, including a special enclosure. Count distinct adjacent hexes: multiple edges touching one water hex count as only one; a larger water area counts only the hexes actually adjacent. Meet any printed one- or two-space requirement.
  4. **Place the Animal card** next to your zoo map, overlapping so the information at the top edge stays visible.
  5. **Execute effects:** advance your Appeal counter by the amount shown; some animals also give conservation points or reputation. "After finishing" effects wait until the entire Animals action is done; all other effects execute immediately, even before playing another Animal card (likewise effects on other cards triggered by the play). If multiple effects are simultaneous, you choose the order.
  - When playing 2 animals, complete all steps for the first (except "after finishing" effects) before the second; you may decline to play a second. Execute "after finishing" effects only after moving the Animals card to slot 1.
- **Side II:** You may also play Animal cards **from the display** within your reputation range, paying an additional cost equal to the folder number the card is on (2 animals may be any mix of hand/display; the display is not replenished until your turn ends). At strength **5 or more**, you may **optionally gain 1 reputation first**, at the very beginning of the action, so the increased range applies to the animals you then play. You may also play animals whose conditions include the upgrade-required icon.

**Animal card layout:** hexagon = minimum standard-enclosure size; adjacent rock/water icons = required adjacent spaces; alternative special enclosure (with spaces occupied) shown beside it; money cost below; extra play conditions lower-left; category and continent icons upper-right (Petting Zoo animals have no continent); appeal gain (plus any conservation/reputation bonuses) lower-right; play effects per the glossary. If an effect refers to an icon that appears on the card itself, that icon counts. Some animals have an **interactive effect**, which can only apply to you if your zoo has **5 or more appeal** (space 5 on the Appeal track is marked as a reminder). Some cards carry a solo-mode replacement effect in a blue box.

**Animal categories (7):** bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear, and Petting Zoo animal. Bear and Petting Zoo animal are special cases (black icon on white background). Bears are more of a subcategory, mostly combined with the herbivore or predator icon. When the game asks for animal categories it includes bear and Petting Zoo animals unless they are explicitly excluded.

### Moving existing animals into a newly built special enclosure

## Special Rules & Edge Cases

- **Reputation cap:** reputation 10+ requires the upgraded Cards action; on space 15, further reputation converts to 1 appeal per step instead.
- **Interactive effects** on Animal cards apply to you only if your zoo has **5 or more appeal**.
- **Full zoo map:** covering every space except water and rock spaces immediately grants 7 appeal (requires the upgraded Build action to reach the restricted spaces; can also trigger from other effects that build in your zoo).
- **Display timing:** whenever you take cards from the display (snap, or upgraded Cards/Animals/Association/Sponsors plays), do not replenish it until your entire turn is complete; then slide cards down folders in order and refill from the deck. **During the break, at step 4 before income**, discard folder 1 and 2 cards, compact the remaining cards and refill the display.
- **Hand size:** unlimited during play; enforced only at breaks (limit 3, or 5 with the specific university).
- **Money-gain timing:** you must be able to pay an animal's full cost before any "gain money" effect from the play pays out.
- **Kiosk spacing** (at least 3 spaces from every other kiosk) applies to every new kiosk, including free ones from card effects (e.g., "Each time you play an Americas icon into your zoo, you may build 1 kiosk for free").
- **Moving animals into a new special enclosure:** allowed only immediately when you build the Reptile House / Large Bird Aviary, once per building. For each animal moved, flip the smallest occupied standard enclosure that meets all its requirements (including water/rock) back to empty; if none does, use the smallest occupied enclosure meeting its size requirement; if none meets even the size, flip none and mark the special enclosure with the suitable number of player tokens; decide per animal.
- **Discarded conservation projects:** tokens on a project card pushed off the display return to the owners' **supply**, not to the bonus spaces on their zoo maps (the bonuses stay activated).
- **2-player game:** one level on each face-up Base Conservation Project and the left column of the donation area are blocked for both players.
- **Multiple simultaneous effects** (appeal, reputation, conservation points, card abilities): the owning player chooses the order of execution.
- **Break trigger from effects:** an Action card, Sponsor card, or Animal card effect can advance the Break token to the last space; the break happens after the current turn ends, the triggering player gains 1 X-token, and extra steps beyond the last space are ignored.
- **Association worker supply:** hire workers from the lowest supply space upward; certain zoo maps reward conservation points for hiring your last worker.
- **Cards that clog:** if you cannot perform any action, the X-token action is always available — unless you already hold 5 X-tokens.
- **Component supply:** if a component runs out, **use a suitable substitute**. Physical stock alone does not forbid an otherwise legal play; explicit per-zoo limits and Association-board availability rules still apply. Keep a few standard enclosures and kiosks/pavilions in reserve.

### Base glossary: shared principles

### Base glossary: shared principles

The seven animal categories are **bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear and Petting Zoo animal**. Bear can appear alongside herbivore or predator; it remains a category. Petting Zoo animal is its own game category. Include both special categories whenever animal categories are requested, unless explicitly excluded.

**Species Diversity** counts different animal categories in your zoo, not the total number of category icons. Repeated copies of one category do not increase diversity; continent and research icons are not animal categories. Its illustrated levels require 5/4/3 different categories for 5/3/2 conservation respectively; choose a fulfilled, unoccupied level under normal support rules.

**Other illustrated project rewards** (left / middle / right levels; choose any fulfilled, unoccupied level under the normal support rules):

| Project in the main-rule examples | Requirement and reward |
|---|---|
| Reptiles | 5 / 4 / 2 reptile icons give 5 / 4 / 2 conservation. |
| Large Animals | 4 / 3 / 2 large animals give 4 / 3 / 2 conservation. Large means printed standard-enclosure requirement 4–5. |
| Aquatic | The visible outer levels require 5 / 2 water icons for 4 / 2 conservation. The middle reward is 3 conservation; use the card’s printed middle requirement, which is obscured in the supplied illustration. |
| Serengeti National Park | Release one Africa animal with printed standard size 4+ / 3 / 2− for 5 / 4 / 3 conservation. Bringing the project into play also grants 1 reputation; supporting it later does not grant that play bonus. |
| Reptile Breeding Program | Have a reptile and a partner zoo from that reptile’s continent; the same condition applies to all three spaces. Their rewards are **2 conservation + 2 reputation / 1 conservation + 2 reputation / 2 conservation**. Choose any available space. |


Card text takes priority over general rules. Cards count their own icons for instant effects and recurring triggers. Only upper-right card icons, partner-zoo/university icons and upper-left water/rock requirements count as zoo icons; left-side conditions and conservation-project icons do not. Doubled icons count twice and trigger matching effects twice. Terrain adjacency counts distinct hexes: touching one water hex in a larger water area gives one adjacency; several edges touching that hex still give only one. Water/rock illustrations on tiles provide neither terrain spaces nor requirements.

A connected space is **uncovered** and shares an edge with a covered space. An isolated space has no adjacent covered space. A border space lacks a neighboring map hex on at least one of its six sides. "Your zoo" includes your played cards, map and personal supply; "any zoo" includes these for all players.

For an effect written "X : Y," **X on the left is the condition and Y on the right is the reward**. A condition without a number (or with "per") pays once per fulfillment. A numbered threshold pays only once; with several thresholds use the highest one met. Blue effects are permanent/recurring, purple gives break income, yellow is an instant play benefit and brown is final scoring.

A numbered threshold pays only once; with several thresholds use the highest one met. Blue effects are permanent/recurring, purple gives break income, yellow is an instant play benefit and brown is final scoring.

Unique buildings must be placed when playing their Sponsor: if placement is impossible, the card cannot be played. Use the matching tile, colored face up; rotate it freely, but do not flip it. Apply ordinary placement rules and any terrain requirements; no size-based construction payment is due. Unique buildings are not enclosures, cannot house additional animals and never count as water or rock spaces.

### Base animal ability clarifications

These clarify the abilities printed on cards; follow each card for its specified amount.

- **Action / Determination:** finish Animals, including moving its card to slot 1, before taking the granted action. Use its Action card normally and move it to slot 1 afterward. A named Action (such as Sponsors) cannot be replaced by taking an X-token; Determination grants any action and may choose the X-token alternative.
- **Boost / Clever:** execute after finishing Animals and moving that card. Clever puts the chosen card into slot 1; cards formerly to its left shift right. Boost puts the named card into slot 1 or 5; moving to 5 shifts cards formerly to its right left.
- **Assertion / Dominance:** search the unused face-down base-project deck, add the chosen project (Assertion) or named project (Dominance) to hand, and return the deck. Dominance has no effect if its named project is already in play. Later play and immediately support the obtained card through Association, placing it **above** the board; it does not join the setup base row below.
- **Digging 2** (illustrated Crested Porcupine): choose **up to twice** between discarding a display card and replenishing it, or discarding a hand card then drawing one deck card. **Digging:** decide again after each card which option to use. A display card discarded through Digging is replaced **immediately**, shifting higher folders down and drawing into folder 6.
- **Flock Animal:** if another herbivore in your zoo requires at least the flock animal's standard-enclosure size, you need not flip an empty enclosure. The same qualifying herbivore can host any number of flock animals and need not itself be a flock animal. Without a qualifying herbivore, house the flock animal normally; a later non-flock herbivore cannot join it in that enclosure. Releasing a flock animal still frees an occupied enclosure under the release/fallback procedure even if the flock animal originally shared. Exact historical residents are not tracked.
- **Full-throated:** activate the lowest remaining reserve worker, moving it to the notepad for immediate use. Take a last-worker map reward if shown. If all workers are active, this ability has no effect.
- **Perception X:** draw X cards from the deck, keep half and discard the rest.
- **Pack 1** (illustrated Lion): when played, gain one additional appeal per predator icon in **your own zoo**, including this animal’s own predator icon. This counts icons already present when played, rather than rewarding future predators. Keep this ability-earned appeal if the animal is later released.
- **Hunter X:** reveal X deck cards, add one revealed Animal card to hand and discard all other revealed cards. With no Animal among them, discard all.
- **Snapping:** take exactly one display card regardless of reputation; drawing from the deck is not an alternative. **Sponsor Magnet:** the display sponsors need not be in reputation range; if no sponsor is present, nothing happens. Ordinary end-of-turn display refill applies.
- **Iconic Animal: Europe** (illustrated Eurasian Lynx): when played, gain one appeal per Europe icon in **all zoos combined**, including your own and this animal’s own icon, up to **eight appeal** from the ability. This is an immediate count of icons already present, rather than a recurring reward for future plays.
- **Sprint 3:** draw three cards from the deck (as on the illustrated Cheetah).
- **Scavenging:** shuffle the discard pile face down, draw randomly from it, make the card's stated selection, then return the discard pile face up. The illustrated **Scavenging 3** draws three random discard-pile cards, keeps one and discards the others. **Sunbathing X:** you may sell up to X hand cards for four money each; sold cards go to the discard pile.
- **Pouch X:** you may tuck up to X hand cards under this card for **two appeal per card**. Tucked cards have no remaining function. If the animal is released, discard its tucked cards too, but retain the appeal already earned by tucking them.
- **Resistance:** an extra Final Scoring card drawn before the 10-conservation milestone joins your choices when you discard one card. At game end score every remaining Final Scoring card, each subject to its own four-point cap.
- **Petting Zoo animal:** your first grants 3 appeal, second 6, third 9. The single Petting Zoo holds at most three such animals. They count as small animals.
- **Posturing:** normal placement rules apply, including kiosk spacing; place multiple buildings one at a time.
- **Peacocking:** you may place the Large Bird Aviary before upgrading Build. **Your zoo must not already have an Aviary, and there must be a legal site.** Other placement restrictions still apply, including Build II for upgrade-marked map spaces.

**Multiplier.** Place a gained token immediately onto the named Action card; a bonus-tile Multiplier may go on any card, including Animals. On its next use you may execute that action twice in succession at the same base strength, moving its Action card only after both executions. Each X-token boosts only one execution. Each additional Multiplier used adds one execution: two tokens permit up to three actions, not four. You may choose different permitted options within each regular execution (Sponsors could play cards then take money). A multiplied X-token alternative may take two X-tokens, subject to the five-token cap, but may not mix one X-token action with one regular action. Defer after-finishing effects until all executions are done. A break triggered by the first execution waits until the entire turn is finished. Return used tokens to the supply; an unused token is removed during the next break.

**Interactive abilities. Eligibility for all four abilities below: an affected zoo must have at least 5 appeal.** If the multiplayer group prefers, replace interactive abilities with the alternative text marked for solo on those cards; this does not require playing the solo mode. The playing animal's appeal may be awarded before or after its ability, so its new appeal normally need not count when deciding the affected player.

**Interactive target reference:** every affected zoo must have at least **5 appeal**.

| Ability | Target selection and special cases |
|---|---|
| Venom X | Every other zoo with higher appeal than yours and at least 5 appeal. |
| Hypnosis | The zoo with highest appeal and at least 5 appeal; choose among ties. If that zoo is yours, no effect. Copy only slot **1, 2 or 3**. |
| Pilfering 1 | The zoo with highest appeal and at least 5 appeal; choose among ties. A self-target has no effect. |
| Pilfering 2 | Resolve the highest-appeal target and the most-conservation target separately, each with at least 5 appeal. The conservation target must have at least 1 conservation. Choose ties; a self-target has no effect. If one zoo leads both tracks, pilfer from it twice. |
| Constriction | Every other zoo with at least 5 appeal that is ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation. Ahead on one track gives **1 token** (slot 5); ahead on both gives **2 tokens** (slots 4 and 5). |

- **Constriction:** affect all other zoos ahead of yours on appeal and/or conservation. A zoo ahead on one track receives Constriction 1; ahead on both receives Constriction 2. Place tokens on cards in the highest slots (one on 5, or two on 4 and 5). Never stack two Constriction tokens on one card; return duplicates. An affected action loses two strength; this applies to each execution of a multiplied action. X-tokens can restore strength. At effective strength zero or below, use enough X-tokens to reach at least one, use the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3. Return the token after acting, or without effect in the break.
- **Venom X:** affect every other zoo with higher appeal than yours, subject to the five-appeal eligibility floor. Place X tokens on cards in the lowest slots (1, then 2, etc.), at most one per card; duplicates return to supply. Using a card with Venom removes its token and avoids all Venom fees that turn. This includes the alternative X-token action if you hold fewer than five X-tokens. **Pay two money at turn end only if you removed no Venom token during this turn and at least one Venom token still remains on your cards.** If you cannot, undo the turn and choose a different action; you cannot escape the fee by spending all your money. The next break clears unused tokens without effect.
- **Hypnosis:** choose the affected player among ties for highest appeal; if you yourself are the target it has no effect. Choose only a card in the target's **slot 1, 2 or 3**. Execute the targeted Action card using its owner's upgraded/unupgraded side for that whole action. Other action-card upgrade checks use your own cards. You may spend your own X-tokens. Venom and Constriction on the targeted card apply to you and are discarded afterward; its Multiplier cannot be used. Move the targeted card to slot 1 normally.
  For the action being copied, its target-side upgrade permissions apply in full: borrowed Build II permits its special enclosures and restricted map spaces even with your own Build I; borrowed Animals II permits upgrade-conditioned animals even with your own Animals I. Borrowed Association I retains its two-partner limit even with your own Association II. A unique building placed through borrowed Sponsors checks **your own Build side**, because Build is a different Action card.
- **Pilfering X:** Pilfering 1 affects the zoo with highest appeal, which must have **at least 5 appeal**. Pilfering 2 separately affects the zoo with highest appeal **and** the zoo with most conservation points; **each target must have at least 5 appeal**. If the same zoo qualifies for both, pilfer from it twice. Ties for highest appeal or conservation let you choose the affected player; a conservation leader needs at least one conservation point. Self-targeting has no effect. The target chooses to give five money or allow a random hand-card draw (never Final Scoring cards). With no hand cards, give five money; with less than five money, give a card. With neither a card nor five money, give all current money, including zero. Resolve repeated pilferings sequentially; the target may make a different choice each time.
- **Jumping:** reaching the last Break space grants the usual X-token and the break waits until after your whole turn.

### Base Sponsor reference

"I" means an instant benefit on playing; "R" a recurring trigger or ongoing permission; "B" break income; "F" final scoring. Effects referring to icons count the card itself. Unless an effect says "any zoo," use your own zoo. All X-token gains obey the five-token limit. For animal sizes, **small** means printed standard size 1 or 2, including Petting Zoo animals; **large** means size 4 or 5. Size 3 is neither.

- Every actual placement bonus on a border space grants an additional choice of any **uncovered** placement bonus on your map, not necessarily on the border. Several border bonuses permit several extra choices; the copied bonuses can be the same or different. Resolve bonuses in your chosen order.
- F: 1 conservation when all building border spaces are covered (exclude water/rock).

**222 Release of Patents**

- I: 1 conservation per research icon, maximum 3; every other player gains 2 money for each point you receive.

**224 Migration Recording**

- I: 1 X-token. Each Release into the Wild support gives 1 additional conservation. You may repeatedly support the same release project with different qualifying animals, but place at most one token per project per Association action. Each token counts as a separate project support for other effects.

**225 Quarantine Lab**

- I: 1 X-token. Immune to Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis and Pilfering. For the latter two, ignore your counters and find the next qualifying player.
- F: 1 conservation with all five continents.

**226 Foreign Institute**

- I: 2 reputation.
